title: iOS project baseline is in place
statusNote: game/ios already has bundle id com.eddieg.aliensudoku, iOS 15.0 target, iPhone+iPad, scene life cycle, launch storyboard, 1024 px icon without alpha, ATT text and the encryption flag.
steps: Nothing to do: keep IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET 15.0 (Apple's minimum is iOS 13).
Keep SceneDelegate: the UIScene life cycle is required when building with the iOS 27 SDK.
Keep ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption = false (the app only uses HTTPS through iOS).
feedback: Bundle id can't change after the first upload, so it is final now.
A layered Icon Composer icon is optional and needs a Mac with macOS Tahoe 26.4+.
doneMessage: The Xcode project already meets Apple's baseline, so the work left is accounts, privacy and ads.

title: Decide: enroll as individual or organization
statusNote: No Apple account exists yet; the choice decides the seller name and paperwork.
time: 15 min (org: +up to 7 business days for D-U-N-S)
steps: Individual: seller name on the App Store is your personal legal name.
Organization: needs a legal entity (LLC), a free D-U-N-S number, a website on its own domain and a work email on that domain.
Sole proprietors must enroll as individuals.
Pick individual unless you already have, or want, an LLC.
feedback: DBAs and trade names are not accepted for organizations.
Converting individual to organization later means contacting Apple; no timeline is promised.
As an EU 'trader' your address/P.O. box, phone and email are shown to EU users either way.
doneMessage: Choice made; you can enroll right away.

title: Enroll in the Apple Developer Program
statusNote: The owner has no Apple Developer membership yet.
steps: Make sure your Apple Account uses your legal first and last name and has two-factor authentication on.
Enroll at developer.apple.com/programs/enroll or in the Apple Developer app on iPhone.
Pay with a card in your own name.
Accept the Apple Developer Program License Agreement.
Write down your 10-character Team ID from the Membership page.
feedback: Nicknames or aliases in the name fields delay approval.
Paying with someone else's card triggers a photo ID request.
Apple gives no approval time; 2026 forum reports range from 48 hours to 3 weeks.
If the membership lapses, the app is pulled from the App Store until you renew.
doneMessage: You're in: App Store Connect, TestFlight and Mac signing are unlocked.

title: Accept agreements (no Paid Apps needed)
statusNote: No account yet; a free app with AdMob ads needs only the developer agreement.
steps: In App Store Connect > Business, accept any pending agreement updates (the DPLA changed on Oct 13, 2026).
Skip the Paid Apps Agreement, banking and tax forms: the app is free with no In-App Purchases.
Set up AdMob payments and tax info with Google instead; ad income comes from Google.
feedback: Unaccepted agreement updates block submissions; check the Business page before each submission.
You'll need the Paid Apps Agreement only for a paid Mac App Store version or IAP like 'remove ads'.
doneMessage: Agreements done; nothing else financial is needed on the Apple side for a free app.

title: Declare EU Digital Services Act trader status
statusNote: No account yet; without a status the app isn't offered in the EU.
steps: Decide: an ad-sponsored app is a listed trader factor, so declare yourself a trader.
Optionally get a P.O. box and a dedicated email/phone for public display.
In App Store Connect, enter the address (or P.O. box), phone and email.
Confirm the email and phone with the codes Apple sends.
Upload a document proving the name and address (for a P.O. box, a bill or receipt).
Certify that you follow EU law.
feedback: These details are shown publicly on the EU product page.
Declaring 'not a trader' tells EU users consumer rights don't apply; ask a lawyer if unsure.
Apple removes apps without a trader status from the EU storefronts.
doneMessage: EU storefronts are open to Alien Sudoku.

title: Check age-assurance, COPPA and image rights
statusNote: Texas SB 2420 applies since Jun 4, 2026, the art looks cute, and space photo licenses are unverified.
steps: Read Apple's age assurance Q&A and decide with a lawyer whether you must check age ranges (Texas, Utah, Louisiana).
Keep all marketing aimed at teens and adults; never say 'for kids'.
If many players may be under 13, ask Claude to add a neutral age question and child-directed ad requests.
Find the source and license of each space photo in game/public/space and add credits in About.
feedback: App Review doesn't test the state laws today, but liability is yours.
ESA images are often CC BY-SA 3.0 IGO: credit and share-alike apply.
App Store Connect asks you to confirm rights to third-party content.
doneMessage: Legal loose ends are known and the content rights answer is honest.

title: Publish privacy, support pages and app-ads.txt
statusNote: docs/PRIVACY.md still has [Your name]/[email] placeholders and no site hosts it yet.
steps: Claude: finish docs/PRIVACY.md (name, email, retention, deletion, how to revoke consent).
Claude: create privacy, support (with contact email) and marketing pages.
You: host them on a domain root you control (user.github.io or a custom domain).
Put app-ads.txt with your AdMob publisher line at the domain root.
Use that site as the Marketing URL in App Store Connect.
feedback: app-ads.txt only works at the domain root; a GitHub Pages project path won't verify.
Apple requires the support URL to show real contact info.
Broken or placeholder URLs are a 2.1 rejection.
doneMessage: You have the three URLs App Store Connect asks for, and AdMob can verify app-ads.txt.

title: Add PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy to the iOS app
statusNote: No privacy manifest in the App target, but @capacitor/preferences uses UserDefaults, so uploads get rejected (ITMS-91053).
steps: Create game/ios/App/App/PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy.
Declare NSPrivacyAccessedAPICategoryUserDefaults with reason CA92.1.
Set NSPrivacyTracking false and leave tracking domains and collected data empty (Google's SDK ships its own).
Add the file to the App target's Resources in project.pbxproj.
After the first archive, check Xcode's privacy report and the upload email.
feedback: The file name must be exactly PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy.
Capacitor and Cordova are on Apple's SDK list; Capacitor 8 ships its own manifests.
Re-check when adding any plugin that touches files, disk space, boot time or keyboards.
doneMessage: The biggest upload blocker is gone.

title: Add privacy policy and Report-an-ad links in app
statusNote: Settings has no privacy policy link (5.1.1(i)) and no way to report ads (2.5.18).
steps: Add a 'Privacy policy' button in Settings > Privacy & data that opens the hosted policy.
Add 'Report an inappropriate ad' that opens an email or form (include time and screen).
Show both only where ads exist, or always for the policy.
Mention both in the App Review notes.
feedback: Guideline 2.5.18 now requires a way to report inappropriate or age-inappropriate ads.
Missing in-app privacy links are a common 5.1.1 rejection.
doneMessage: Two likely rejection reasons are fixed.

title: Switch to real AdMob ids, SKAdNetworks, ad rating
statusNote: Info.plist and ads.js use Google test ids, only 1 SKAdNetwork id, and no maxAdContentRating.
time: 1 hour after AdMob is set up
steps: You: create the iOS app and banner, interstitial and rewarded units in AdMob; publish the GDPR and IDFA explainer messages.
You: set AdMob blocking controls to max ad content rating G or PG and block sensitive categories.
Claude: run tools/set-admob-ids.mjs and set the VITE_ADMOB_IOS_* values or secrets.
Claude: add Google's full SKAdNetwork list to Info.plist.
Claude: pass maxAdContentRating 'ParentalGuidance' (or 'General') to AdMob.initialize().
feedback: Ads must fit the 9+ age rating (2.5.18).
Register your phone as a test device; never tap your own live ads.
developers.google.com was unreachable here; fetch the SKAdNetwork list where it is reachable.
doneMessage: Builds now earn money and show age-appropriate ads.

title: Check iPad, landscape and resizable window layouts
statusNote: The app is universal with all iPad orientations, and iPadOS 26 lets users resize windows freely.
steps: Use Playwright on the web build at iPad 13", 11" and small window sizes, portrait and landscape.
Check iPhone landscape; if it looks poor, drop landscape from the iPhone orientations.
Check the iPhone Duo inner screen ratio (about 2007x2853).
Fix any overflow, tiny board or overlapping banner.
feedback: App Review tests universal apps on iPad; a stretched phone layout gets rejected under 4.0/2.4.1.
UIRequiresFullScreen is ignored from iPadOS 26.
doneMessage: The game looks right on every screen App Review might use.

title: Get a Mac build path working
statusNote: There is no Mac, and GitHub Actions jobs fail in ~2 seconds without a runner on this account.
steps: First try: fix GitHub billing/spending limit or account flag, then re-run the workflow (the repo is public).
Fallback: Codemagic personal account (500 free macOS minutes/month) with a codemagic.yaml.
Or rent a Mac (MacinCloud pay-as-you-go) or borrow one for a manual archive.
Xcode Cloud only after one Mac session, since Apple requires Xcode for the first workflow.
feedback: macos-latest runs macOS 26 with Xcode 26.6, which meets today's rule.
From April 2027 builds need Xcode 27 (GitHub label xcode-27 is in preview).
Pricing for Codemagic, MacinCloud and GitHub was not re-verified here.
doneMessage: You can produce signed iOS builds without owning a Mac.

title: Register bundle id com.eddieg.aliensudoku
statusNote: Needs the developer account; the id already matches the Xcode project.
steps: developer.apple.com > Certificates, Identifiers & Profiles > Identifiers > +.
Choose App IDs > App, explicit id com.eddieg.aliensudoku, description Alien Sudoku.
Leave all capabilities off (no push, no Game Center).
feedback: The id must match Xcode exactly and is permanent after the first upload.
doneMessage: The bundle id now appears in App Store Connect's New App form.

title: Create the app in App Store Connect
statusNote: No App Store Connect account or app record exists yet.
steps: App Store Connect > Apps > + > New App.
Platform iOS, name Alien Sudoku, language English (U.S.).
Bundle id com.eddieg.aliensudoku, SKU alien-sudoku-ios, Full Access.
Create it now to reserve the name.
feedback: Names are 2-30 characters and must be unique on the App Store.
SKU can't be changed later.
doneMessage: The app exists in App Store Connect; builds can be uploaded to it.

title: Create an Admin App Store Connect API key
statusNote: Repo docs say 'App Manager', but cloud signing via xcodebuild with an API key only works with an Admin key.
steps: Users and Access > Integrations > App Store Connect API (request access first if asked).
Team Keys > + > name 'CI', role Admin.
Download the .p8 (only once) and note the Key ID and Issuer ID.
Store it in a password manager, never in git.
feedback: With an App Manager key the build fails with 'Cloud signing permission error'.
Revoke the key right away if it leaks.
doneMessage: CI can now sign and upload builds for you.

links.label: Forum: Admin needed for cloud signing

title: Add Apple secrets and fix CI signing docs
statusNote: The iOS job exists but GitHub Actions doesn't start, and docs name the wrong key role.
steps: You: add APPLE_TEAM_ID, ASC_KEY_ID, ASC_ISSUER_ID and ASC_KEY_P8_BASE64 as secrets.
Claude: change 'App Manager' to 'Admin' in docs/STORE_CHECKLIST.md and the iOS prompt.
Claude: pin runs-on to macos-26 now and plan xcode-27 before April 2027.
Claude: if Codemagic is chosen, add codemagic.yaml with the same steps.
feedback: Build numbers come from the run number; never reuse one.
If manual signing is preferred, store a distribution .p12 and profile instead.
doneMessage: Every push can produce a TestFlight build.

title: Archive and upload the first build
statusNote: Needs a working Mac/CI path, the privacy manifest and the app record.
steps: Run the iOS job (or archive on a Mac: npm ci, npm run cap:sync, Xcode > Product > Archive).
Upload to App Store Connect.
Read the processing email for ITMS warnings (privacy, SDK signatures).
Confirm the build shows in TestFlight with no 'Missing Compliance'.
feedback: Uploads must use Xcode 26+ now and Xcode 27 from April 2027.
Fix every ITMS warning before submitting for review.
doneMessage: Your first iOS build is in App Store Connect.

title: Test on iPhone and iPad with TestFlight
statusNote: No build has been uploaded yet.
steps: Add yourself as an internal tester (up to 100, no review needed).
Install TestFlight from the App Store and accept the invite.
Fresh install: check the consent message, then the ATT system prompt.
Check banner, interstitials (close button), rewarded hint and second chance.
Check Settings links, offline play, iPad portrait/landscape, resume after background.
Optional: external group (up to 10,000) after Beta App Review.
feedback: Builds expire after 90 days.
If the ATT prompt doesn't appear, App Review will reject under 5.1.2/2.1.
Use test-device mode so your own taps don't count as invalid traffic.
doneMessage: You know the release build works on real hardware.

title: Answer the age rating questionnaire (9+)
statusNote: Needs the app record; answers are known from the game's content.
steps: App Information > Age Ratings > Set Up.
In-app controls: none. Capabilities: Advertising Yes; web, UGC, chat, social media No.
Shared Location No; Dating and Relationships No.
Horror/Fear Themes: Infrequent/Mild. Everything else None/No.
Age Categories and Override: Not Applicable. Never pick Made for Kids.
feedback: Expected result: 9+. 'Frequent' horror would make it 13+.
Made for Kids can't be undone after approval and bans AdMob behavioral ads.
New descriptors must be answered by Jan 12, 2027.
doneMessage: The rating matches the game, and the ad settings can match the rating.

title: Fill in App Privacy for AdMob
statusNote: Needs the app record and the hosted privacy policy URL.
steps: Enter the privacy policy URL.
Data collected: Yes.
Coarse Location, Device ID, Product Interaction, Advertising Data: Third-Party Advertising + Analytics, linked, used for tracking.
Crash, Performance, Other Diagnostic Data: Analytics, not linked, not tracking.
Nothing else: progress and the typed name never leave the device.
Publish.
feedback: Apple treats personal data under privacy laws (IDFA, IP) as linked; 'linked' is the safe answer.
Labels must match the ATT prompt and the privacy policy.
Re-check against Google's data-disclosure page when SDK versions change.
doneMessage: Your privacy label is honest and consistent with the ATT prompt.

title: Make iPhone and iPad screenshots
statusNote: Only three web screenshots exist in docs/; none are at App Store sizes.
steps: Render 6-8 shots with Playwright, ad banner hidden.
iPhone 6.9": 1320x2868. iPhone 6.3": 1206x2622 (required).
iPad 13": 2064x2752 (required).
Optional now, required April 2027: iPhone Duo 2007x2853 and 1398x2034.
Export PNG without alpha; check a few against a real device.
feedback: Show gameplay, not just title art (2.3.3).
Keep images 4+ friendly: avoid the gnarliest monsters (2.3.8).
No prices, other platforms or 'for kids'.
doneMessage: All required screenshot slots can be filled.

title: Enter name, subtitle, keywords and description
statusNote: Draft text exists in docs/STORE_CHECKLIST.md, but its keywords repeat the app name.
steps: Subtitle (max 30): Decode glyph logic puzzles.
Keywords (max 100 bytes): puzzle,logic,brain,daily,space,ufo,glyph,number,zen,offline,classic,grid,cosmic,mind,streak,duel.
Description (max 4000): reuse the checklist text.
Promotional text (max 170), support, marketing and privacy URLs.
Copyright: 2026 + your legal name. Category: Games > Puzzle, Board.
feedback: Don't put other apps' names or 'sudoku app' brand names in keywords (2.3.7).
Don't mention Android, Google Play or the web version (2.3.10).
doneMessage: The product page reads well and is searchable.

title: Set price Free and choose countries
statusNote: Needs the app record.
steps: Pricing and Availability: Free.
Select all countries except China mainland and Vietnam (licensing).
Turn off 'iPhone and iPad Apps on Apple Silicon Mac' availability.
Check the Apple Vision Pro availability setting too.
feedback: China mainland needs an ICP filing and likely a game approval number.
Vietnam requires games to be licensed or notified.
Keeping the iOS app off Macs avoids competing with the paid desktop build.
doneMessage: The app will launch where you can legally sell it.

title: Fill in Accessibility Nutrition Labels
statusNote: Voluntary today, but one report says an empty section delayed availability.
steps: App Store Connect > App Accessibility.
Claim only features tested end to end (e.g., Dark Interface).
Save even if you claim none.
feedback: Apple says labels become mandatory over time; no date yet.
Over-claiming VoiceOver support invites complaints.
doneMessage: No surprises when the version goes live.

title: Write review notes and submit for App Review
statusNote: Nothing is uploaded or filled in yet.
steps: Claude: draft review notes (no login, ad formats, consent then ATT, where the links are, 9+).
Select the TestFlight-tested build on the 1.0 version page.
Content rights: Yes, you have rights. Sign-in required: No.
Version release: Manual.
Add for Review > Submit.
feedback: Apple reviews 50% of submissions in under 24 h and 90% in under 48 h.
Top risks: 2.1 crash or test ads, 5.1.1 policy link, 5.1.2 ATT, 2.5.18 ads, 4.2/4.3.
Never select Made for Kids.
doneMessage: Alien Sudoku is in Apple's review queue.

title: Respond to App Review if rejected
statusNote: Not submitted yet.
steps: Read the message in the app's App Review section; note the guideline number.
Metadata issue: fix in App Store Connect and resubmit.
Binary issue: Claude fixes, new build number, upload, resubmit.
Reply politely with specifics if the reviewer misunderstood.
Last resort: one appeal to the App Review Board.
feedback: Screenshots or a short video of the ATT prompt often settle 5.1.2 questions.
Stay factual; arguments about other apps don't help.
doneMessage: Approved, or you know exactly what to change.

title: Release and link the app in AdMob
statusNote: Waits for approval.
time: 30 min + up to ~7 days app-ads.txt check
steps: Press Release This Version.
In AdMob, link the iOS app to its App Store listing.
Check that app-ads.txt shows as verified.
Set promotional text and reply to early reviews.
feedback: Ad fill can be limited until AdMob verifies the app.
If the app stays 'Processing' for hours, check the accessibility section.
doneMessage: Alien Sudoku is live on the App Store and earning from ads.

title: Prepare for Jan-Apr 2027 Apple deadlines
statusNote: CI uses Xcode 26.6; no Duo screenshots; new age questions not answered.
steps: By Jan 12, 2027: answer Shared Location and Dating (No/No) in the age rating.
Before April 2027: build with Xcode 27 / iOS 27 SDK (CI label xcode-27 or macOS 27).
Test on iPhone Duo in Device Hub and add Duo screenshots.
Renew membership and keep TestFlight builds fresh (90 days).
feedback: Updates built with the iOS 27.1 SDK or later need iPhone Duo screenshots from April 2027.
Watch developer.apple.com/news for new requirements.
doneMessage: Updates keep flowing after Apple's 2027 changes.

title: Sign and notarize the Mac desktop build
statusNote: desktop/package.json has identity null, there's no Developer ID cert, and signing needs macOS.
steps: You (Account Holder): create a Developer ID Application cert from the G2 Sub-CA; export .p12.
Add CSC_LINK, CSC_KEY_PASSWORD and APPLE_API_KEY, APPLE_API_KEY_ID, APPLE_API_ISSUER secrets.
Claude: remove "identity": null and enable notarization in the mac build job.
Run on a macOS runner; check with spctl and stapler validate.
Claude: update RUN.md and the desktop prompt (right-click Open is outdated).
feedback: The old Developer ID Sub-CA expires Feb 1, 2027; only use G2 certificates.
Keep the universal build: macOS 27 is the last with Rosetta.
rcodesign can sign/notarize from Linux if no Mac runner works (untested here).
doneMessage: Mac players on Steam, GOG and itch can open the game without warnings.

title: Decide later on a Mac App Store version
statusNote: PC price is undecided and no MAS build target exists.
steps: Wait until the iOS launch and desktop price are settled.
If yes: new macOS app record with its own bundle id (e.g., com.eddieg.aliensudoku.mac).
Claude adds an electron-builder mas target with sandbox entitlements.
Sign the Paid Apps Agreement, tax and banking; join the Small Business Program.
Mac screenshots at 2880x1800 (16:10).
feedback: Mac App Store apps must be sandboxed and update only through the store (2.4.5).
Using the iOS bundle id would make it a free universal purchase.
doneMessage: You've made a deliberate call on the Mac App Store.
